  Help  General   Commands   Custom commands
  Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with your permission, and runs commands — right from your terminal.
  Shortcuts
  ! for shell mode        esc esc to clear input             ctrl+shift+_ to undo
  / for commands          shift+tab to cycle modes           ctrl+z to suspend
  @ for file paths        ctrl+o to see full transcript      ctrl+v to paste images
  /btw for side question  ctrl+t to toggle tasks             alt+p to switch model
                          backslash (\) then enter for       ctrl+s to stash prompt
                          newline                            ctrl+g to edit in $EDITOR
                                                             /keybindings to customize
  For more help: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview
  ←/→ to switch · Esc to close
